It has higher health and speed as the [[Hefty]], though instead of [[Defense]] it has [[Health Regen]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Even in death one shall serve the Void. Corpses of those whose realms were devoured decompose in the peaceful quiet and are scavenged by Odds or Swifts. They are then brought back to the Void Caster as an offering, as she then attaches a Phantom or an Odd’s soul directly into it. Many of the Swifts, Heftys and Odds don’t like interacting with the Cursed Skeleton, as they fear what it would be like not having flesh.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Cursed Skeleton''' is a grey and purple skeleton which has vines, flowers and various other plants covering or growing inside of it. It has glowing purple eyes. |Legacy |The legacy '''Cursed Skeleton''' is made entirely of blackish-purple parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies, and has two large glowing purple eyeholes. It also emits purple particles and the ends of its limbs are covered in a purple fluid. It plays a bone shaking sound on death. }} ==Strategy== *'''Cursed Skeletons''' can be easily dealt with by towers that deal a lot of damage, such as the [[Saboteur]], [[Engineer]], [[Crook Boss]] [[Golden Crook Boss]] or [[Operator]]. *As the '''Cursed Skeleton''' spawns in groups, splash damage towers such as the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Golden Demoman]] can also be useful against it. *The [[Bloated]] '''Cursed Skeletons''' on Wave 9 and 12 of [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] can be very challenging to deal with if DPS is lacking. It is recommended to use cost-efficient DPS towers to deal with them effectively. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- |[[File:SkeletonDeath2.ogg]] |Death sound |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (legacy)}} CorpseCursedSkeleton.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} V1.86.0UpdateLog1.png|'''Cursed Skeleton''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexCursedSkeleton.png|Legacy '''Cursed Skeleton''' on its [[Index]] icon.
